messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "minimize risk of sleep disturbances"
set: ["minimize risk of sleep disturbances", "titration should minimize adverse reactions", "adjust diuretic dose to minimize hypovolemia", "individual risk of cardiovascular events", "drink plenty of fluids to reduce risk of dehydration", "this raises the risk of side effects", "follow the dose escalation schedule to minimize gastrointestinal adverse reactions", "morning dose may also help you sleep better", "moistening mouth with sips of water before dosing reduces risk of numbness", "avoid activities that increase risk of bleeding or injury", "long term use may increase risk of broken bone", "skipping doses can increase risk of infection resistant to medication", "talk to doctor about risk", "drink 8 to 10 full glasses of fluid every day to reduce risk of kidney stones", "use more than once per day may increase risk of broken bone", "ask your doctor about any risk"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
